pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit sequential scaling or adding positions within a 10-pip range of an existing active trade to eliminate compounding drawdown on false breakouts.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated multi-timeframe volume-weighted average price (VWAP) cross combined with an institutional order book imbalance confirmation prior to order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing locks as soon as floating profits hit +$12.00 to guarantee terminal capture within the $15-$30+ target bracket.
